name: WiFi pull through the site's LAN test server
reviewer_setup: On the site worktree, enable CF_TEST_MODE in a local-only config and start C:/php/php.exe -S 0.0.0.0:8000 -t . from the site root. Use the site's device-pair test flow to link this device id and stage one wasm add with a blob. Set CF_BENCH_BASE to http://<LAN-IP>:8000, CF_BENCH_TOKEN to the 43-character linked device credential, CF_BENCH_BAD_TOKEN to a different unlinked 43-character credential, CF_BENCH_APP_NAME to the staged entry's menu name, and CF_BENCH_APP_ID to its manifest id. The local_test firmware and saved wificfg STA credentials are required. The server enforces a 60-second check-in floor, so each cloud check can take over a minute. Run python test/bench/cf_replay.py test/bench/cases/wifi-pull.json --port <PORT>. Use an isolated test data directory; never use a live account. The start-up check-in would otherwise take the staged app before the first cloud check: the case unlinks the unit (link forget, test builds only) before its reset and checks that the start-up check did not run, then sets the credential. Opening the port also restarts the unit, so start with the unit not linked with CF_BENCH_TOKEN (the case ends unlinked, so reruns are fine).
